entities.summary: Damian Thomas Keogh is an Australian former professional basketball player who played his career in Australia's National Basketball League for the Nunawading Spectres, Bankstown Bruins, West Sydney Westars and Sydney Kings from 1980 to 1995. He also represented the Australian team at the 1984, 1988 and 1992 Summer Olympic Games.
